title: feat(spec, cli)!: refuse an address-literal namespace at defineStack, os validate and os build, and name an installed one in the upgrade report
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi96gfKKRtqJ3JMFMFPUmFbPX)_
Fixes #31968

Clause-②: no (narrowing) — item 1: `defineStack`, `os validate` and `os build` refuse a namespace (the stack's own, or a `packages[]` body's) equal to `actions`, `connectors`, `global`, `hooks`, `oauth` or `trigger`; measured: with the new call removed (the base c9246279 path, by the ablation legs below) `defineStack` returns a stack and `os validate` / `os build` exit 0 with the artifact written; on head they refuse (`STACK_NAMESPACE_PREFIX_INVALID` 422 / exit 1, no artifact). Item 2 widens a report's output only: `os migrate stored-references` gains the `literalNamespaces` section; no accept set moves.
Metadata-protocol: narrowed
Skills-docs: none — `skills/**` does not teach a namespace spelled like an address literal; the rule ships in the refusal text and in ADR-0150 D5.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：`defineStack`、`os validate`、`os build` 在构建期就拒绝六个路由字面量命名空间（actions/connectors/global/hooks/oauth/trigger）；升级报告 `os migrate stored-references` 新增一段，点名已安装的这类包。
- 为什么改：此前只有运行中的安装入口拒绝，新包要到安装时才知道不行；已装的包启动只打一条日志，运维看不到。
- 风险与回滚：一方普查为 0，只影响用了这六个命名空间的第三方包作者；回滚即 revert 本 PR，服务端启动与安装入口行为不变。
- 先看：`packages/spec/src/stack.zod.ts`（validateNamespacePrefix 新增的一个循环）、`packages/cli/src/utils/namespace-address-literals.ts`、`packages/cli/src/utils/stored-package-references.ts`（literalNamespaces）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --project unit test/build-namespace-address-literal.test.ts`，预期 3 个用例全绿（hooks 被 validate/build 拒绝且无产物，triggers 正常构建）。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

**Item 1 — build-time refusal (narrowing).** One judge, three callers: the install door's own `validateNamespaceNotAddressLiteral` (`@objectstack/spec/kernel`, already exported, no new export).

- `packages/spec/src/stack.zod.ts` — `validateNamespacePrefix` asks the judge for every namespace the artifact declares (the namespace list K's clash check already collects: the stack's manifest and each `packages[]` body). The refusal rides the existing `StackNamespacePrefixInvalidError` (`STACK_NAMESPACE_PREFIX_INVALID`, 422); `issues` carries the judge's sentence verbatim. No new error code.
- `packages/cli/src/utils/namespace-address-literals.ts` (new) — the walk `os validate` (step 2c-quater) and `os build` (step 3a-quinquies) hand the judge, shaped like `namespace-object-names.ts`. Rows are `{ namespace, packageId?, message }`; `os build` refuses before any artifact write. Listed on the validate/build parity roster.
- The message names the literal, the doors that serve it, and the remedy ("Choose another namespace.").

**Item 2 — upgrade-report finding (the seam exists: ADR-0150 D10, `os migrate stored-references`).**

- `packages/cli/src/utils/stored-package-references.ts` — the report gains `literalNamespaces`, a list of `{ packageId, namespace, message }`: every installed package (`registry.getAllPackages()`) whose namespace the judge refuses — the packages the boot keeps with one warning. Sorted by package id; reads no table.
- `packages/cli/src/commands/migrate/stored-references/index.ts` — the text face prints each one, adding that its items are read with `?package=ID` and that a rename of its namespace gives them qualified addresses. The "nothing to review" line now also says no namespace spells a literal.

New public names (seat's call, per lane rules): the report key `literalNamespaces` and its row type `LiteralNamespaceFinding`; the CLI row type `NamespaceAddressLiteralRefusalRow`. No new route, no new error code.

## Tests

- `packages/spec/src/stack-namespace-address-literal.test.ts` (new): each of the six refused via `defineStack` (code + status + the judge's sentence), a `packages[]` body refused alone; CONTROL `triggers`, `globals` accepted.
- `packages/cli/src/utils/namespace-address-literals.test.ts` (new): the walk, per literal, per body, deduplicated; CONTROL `triggers` / `globals` / no namespace.
- `packages/cli/test/build-namespace-address-literal.test.ts` (new, unit tier, in-process): `os validate --json` and `os build --json` exit 1 with the judge's row and `dist/` stays empty; the text face names the literal and the remedy; CONTROL `triggers` validates and builds.
- `packages/cli/src/utils/stored-package-references.literal-namespace.test.ts` (new, real `SchemaRegistry`): a held `hooks` package (installed during the cold boot) is named in the report; CONTROL `triggers` reports none; CONTROL a `hooks` install after the seal is refused (`NAMESPACE_CONFLICT` 422) and never reaches the report.
- Forced test edit: `packages/cli/test/validate-build-gate-parity.test.ts` gains the `findNamespaceAddressLiteralRefusals` row in `SHARED_NON_REGISTRY_GATES` (the closed roster requires it).

<details><summary>Ablations (each negative pin, via scripts/ablation-replace.mjs; mutation landed, red, restored with blob == HEAD and git diff HEAD empty)</summary>

- spec `validateNamespacePrefix`: the push of the judge's refusal replaced → `stack-namespace-address-literal.test.ts` 7 failed / 3 passed (`expected undefined to be 'STACK_NAMESPACE_PREFIX_INVALID'`); CONTROL cases stayed green.
- cli `namespace-address-literals.ts`: the judge's verdict replaced by null → the walk test and the command test 10 failed / 2 passed (`expected +0 to be 1` on validate and build).
- cli `compile.ts` wiring alone: the call replaced by an empty list → `build-namespace-address-literal.test.ts` 2 failed / 1 passed (build exits 0).
- cli `stored-package-references.ts`: the judge's verdict replaced by null → the held `hooks` pin red (`expected [] to deeply equal [ { …(3) } ]`), both CONTROLs green.

</details>

<details><summary>Local gates (head 9691ed0c; the 94-family union ran on 04b2348e, the last commit only adds three module-top imports to one test file, and the families reading that file were re-run on 9691ed0c)</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test` exit 0; `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec typecheck` exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --project unit` exit 0 — Test Files 411 passed, Tests 5863 passed; `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli typecheck` exit 0. The cli integration tier is declared to CI (no spawn entry or integration-tier file touched).
- eslint (`--no-inline-config`) over `packages/spec` and `packages/cli`: exit 0.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`: 94 families, all exit 0; `--ran` reconciliation: 94 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a derived zero). First-pass exit 3 on `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:i18n-coverage` (no full build) and `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` (shallow clone) were prerequisites, re-run green after a full build and a fetch; `check:test-source-alias` was red (exit 1) on the new in-process command test and is fixed by the last commit, re-run exit 0 with `check:cross-package-test-inputs`, `check:tier-file-adoption`, `check:nul-bytes`, `check:issue-citations` and the test itself.
- Full dogfood battery (`(narrowing)` arm): runs on the final head; its reading is in the os-dev-report comment on the card.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- The `defineStack` refusal reuses the namespace-prefix header and its writing-style hint ("Every object.name must be …"), which fits this refusal poorly; giving a non-prefix finding its own header is open card #31906's scope, so the hint is left as it is here.
- A deployment's own `objectstack.config.ts` that calls `defineStack` with one of the six namespaces now fails at load — that is the declared narrowing. The server boot's exemption for a package it registers is unchanged (`registry-namespace-address-literal.test.ts` untouched).
- First-party census at c9246279: 0 stacks, examples, fixtures or templates declare one of the six. The only tree hits are a test that installs a `hooks` package straight into the registry (the boot-exemption pin) and `ui/` component-registry namespaces (`global`), which are not package namespaces.

## Verification

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --project unit test/build-namespace-address-literal.test.ts src/utils/namespace-address-literals.test.ts src/utils/stored-package-references.literal-namespace.test.ts`
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run src/stack-namespace-address-literal.test.ts`
